name: Require Revision
description: Lets admins configure which entity types must create a new revision on save.
project_description:
The Require Revision module offers a centralized configuration interface for managing revision requirements across various entity types. Administrators can specify which block types , content types , and taxonomy vocabularies are required to create new revisions when edited . Additionally, they can choose to require revision log messages for these entities . The module tracks and records all edits to blocks, nodes, and terms, ensuring transparency throughout the content workflow.

 
 Features
 
 
 
 The settings page is organized into three collapsible sections:
 
 
 Block Types: Configure revision requirements for custom block types
 
 
 Content Types: Configure revision requirements for node content types
 
 
 Taxonomy Vocabularies: Configure revision requirements for taxonomy terms
 
 
 
 
 Conditional field behavior - require revision log options only available when revision is required
 
 
 "Select all" functionality for quick configuration
 
 
 New content creation is not affected - revision requirements only apply when editing existing content
 
 
 
 How to use
 
 
 
 Install and enable the Require Revision module
 
 
 Go to the settings page : Configuration > Content authoring > Require Revision
 
 
 Select entity types : Expand the section (Block Types, Content Types, or Taxonomy Vocabularies)
 
 
 Check the boxes under "Requiring revisions" for the types you want to enforce
 
 
 (Optional) Check boxes under "Requiring revision log messages" to make log messages mandatory
 
 
 Save configuration 
 
 
 Update note: 
 
 After updating to 1.0.6, please resave the module's settings for the fix to take effect.
